card.summary: Mastra Platform Free, USD 0 a month: 40 vCPU-hours, 360 GB-hours of memory, 100K observability events, 10 GB shared egress, 5 connections and 15-day trace re...

free_tier.stated: Mastra Platform Free, USD 0 a month: 40 vCPU-hours, 360 GB-hours of memory, 100K observability events, 10 GB shared egress, 5 connections and 15-day trace retention; then USD 0.25 per vCPU-hour, USD 0.25 per GB-hour and USD 10 per 100K events. Starter is USD 25 a month. The open-source framework is free to self-host
free_tier.notes: read from the vendor pricing page; the plan is priced a month, and whether the allowance resets monthly is not stated

egress.terms: Shared egress allowance per workspace: Free 10 GB, Starter 25 GB, Team 50 GB, then USD 0.10 per GB; each dedicated project uses its own egress first

record.interface_detail: the mastra CLI starts a local server exposing REST endpoints and Studio; the hosted platform is managed in the Mastra console at projects.mastra.ai
record.tooling: the mastra CLI with mastra deploy to the hosted platform

limits.value: the hosted Free plan includes 40 vCPU-hours, 360 GB-hours of memory and 100K events; usage past them is billed at USD 0.25 per vCPU-hour, USD 0.25 per GB-hour and USD 10 per 100K events

record.limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. Exceeds capacity threshold.
record.confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-29: the hosted Mastra Platform has a Starter plan at $0 a month with 100K events and 24 CPU hours, above Teams at $250 a month. The site read on 2026-10-22 described only the open-source framework

evidence.proved: the site was read on 2026-10-22 and describes an open-source TypeScript agent framework with workflows, memory and a harness; it publishes no plan, price or free tier
the mastra CLI deploys to the hosted platform
evidence.quote: Builds and deploys your project to the Mastra platform environment selected by `--env`.

evidence.proved: the Free plan includes 40 vCPU-hours then USD 0.25 per vCPU-hour; Starter is a separate USD 25 plan
